works.title: On the Holy Spirit
works.subtitle: Popular Patristics Series, Vol. 42
works.author: Basil of Caesarea
works.blurb: Basil's defense of the Spirit's full divinity against the Pneumatomachoi — the work that anchored the Cappadocian settlement and shaped the Creed's third article. Stephen Hildebrand's modern translation.

works.title: On Social Justice
works.subtitle: Popular Patristics Series, Vol. 38
works.author: Basil of Caesarea
works.blurb: Basil's homilies on wealth, almsgiving, famine, and the duties of the rich — a fourth-century challenge that lands as hard today as it did in Caesarea. Translated by C. Paul Schroeder.

works.title: The Doctrine of Deification in the Greek Patristic Tradition
works.subtitle: Oxford Early Christian Studies
works.author: Norman Russell
works.blurb: Russell's standard history of theosis from second-century metaphor to mature Byzantine doctrine — with extensive treatment of Basil and the Cappadocians as the hinge between Athanasius and Maximus, on which Palamas's later essence-energies synthesis depends.
